tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Cayley complex of $\Z \times \Z $] ↗ def:cayley-graph-and-complex 1. ch1:1.46\group Covering Spaces

For $G=\langle x,y\mid xyx^{-1}y^{-1}\rangle $, the Cayley complex is the square grid $\R ^2$ and the quotient is the torus. \end{example}
